items.prompt: What is true about vertical angles?

steps: Opposite angles at an intersection are equal.

items.prompt: If same-side interior angles are $2x$ and $x$, find $x$.
Explain why same-side interior angles are supplementary when lines are parallel.
items.answer: A same-side interior angle and the corresponding angle form a linear pair summing to $180°$, and the corresponding angle equals the other same-side interior angle, so the two same-side interior angles sum to $180°$.

steps: Use the linear pair and corresponding-angle equality.
